title: the peer answers on its own DSH port -> the loopback-only premise is broken
titleZh: 对端在自己的 DSH 端口上有响应 -> loopback-only 前提被破坏
why: If the DSH port answers from the tailnet side, something widened the bind (or a proxy was added). That is worse than an unreachable peer: the narrow ACL no longer protects anything. Must be blocked, not degraded.
inject: TCP probe result for 203.0.113.5:<DSH port> replaced by 'connected'
